title: Track 3 physical verification layer
objective: Independently verify large computational facilities using physical observations, remote sensing, infrastructure records and construction/power chronology without treating any missing layer as evidence of absence.

checklist.coverage: Sentinel-2 and Landsat optical source families are cataloged; raw site scenes are not stored yet. 0 site scenes ingested.
Landsat surface-temperature/TIRS products are publicly available, but no site-level thermal raster/temperature time series has been ingested.
Sentinel-1 SAR is publicly available globally; no site-level SAR scene measurements or change metrics are currently ingested.
90 project/evidence records mention substations, but automated site-level expansion detection has not been performed.

3 source-backed transformer records are retained for 1 Epoch site (Meta Hyperion): 1 planned transformer specification, 1 in-transit delivery report, and 1 delivered campus substation unit. Planned specifications are not treated as proof of installation.
113 project/evidence records contain transmission-line/project references, but site-level construction-event detection is not yet computationally linked.
2 Epoch sites currently have structured cooling-equipment snapshots. Other sites remain not ingested.
No structured site-level generator/backup-generation observation is currently linked to the 93 Epoch IDs.
33 public permit records are ingested in the broader project layer, but they are not yet exhaustively site-linked to every Epoch facility.
54 / 93 sites have current polygonized building-footprint geometry (106759 polygons retained). Dated construction chronology remains a separate layer.
93 / 93 Epoch sites have construction timeline records with dated power/IT-power fields retained.

summary.semantics: Source availability is not ingestion. External project/permit evidence is not treated as a site match until a physical-site linkage exists.

source_catalog.name: Copernicus Sentinel-2
source_catalog.role: Free systematic multispectral imagery for multi-temporal surface/building/campus change detection.

source_catalog.name: USGS Landsat Collection 2 Level-1 / OLI
source_catalog.role: Open Landsat optical imagery and scene metadata for long-term site chronology.

source_catalog.name: USGS Landsat Collection 2 Level-2 Surface Temperature / TIRS
source_catalog.role: Open surface-temperature products and thermal-band observations.

source_catalog.name: Copernicus Sentinel-1 SAR
source_catalog.role: Open radar observations for cloud-independent construction/change detection.

source_catalog.name: USGS 3DEP
source_catalog.role: Public lidar/DEM support for structure/campus geometry; not itself a building-footprint dataset.

source_catalog.name: Epoch AI construction timelines
source_catalog.role: Dated site construction, building, power and progress records for the 93-site Epoch universe.

source_catalog.name: Virginia DEQ issued air permits for data centers
source_catalog.role: Individual permit identities and dates; current project layer contains 33 records.

source_catalog.name: Utility / regulator transmission project filings
source_catalog.role: Public line/substation project evidence; current project layer contains 90 substation-related and 113 transmission-related evidence records.

source_catalog.name: HV transformer procurement / delivery / installation evidence
source_catalog.role: Target stream for order, manufacturer, MVA/kV, destination and installation-event evidence.

acquisition_pipeline.processing: Public raw COG windows are read around geocoded public site addresses; compact derived metrics and scene provenance are retained, while full rasters remain external.
acquisition_pipeline.semantics: Acquisition success is not itself evidence of AI compute activity. Missing observations remain explicit gaps.
